cohort: 80 women with normal singleton pregnancies at 38-40 weeks gestation
finding: More than 80% of placental residual blood volume could be collected within 60 seconds of cord drainage after vaginal delivery, 120 seconds after cesarean delivery, and seven repetitions of cord milking in both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: More than 80% of placental residual blood volume could be collected within 60 seconds of cord drainage after vaginal delivery and 120 seconds after cesarean delivery.
